groups.source_support: The PDF explicitly defines each named item's core effect. Class-level sections also define bounded implement behavior such as wand charges/recharge/activation, staff charges/recharge, rod charge/control conventions, scroll single-use behavior, orb activation, charm/talisman triggers, and ring spell-storage/reactive behavior. Item-specific inferred range/uses/capacity/durability details that are not stated remain recommendations, not source facts.
groups.disposition: Retain explicit source effect; keep non-stated operational numbers visibly inferred and route numerical balance to PPIA-11.

groups.source_support: The PDF names these objects only in GM combination/examples or narrative prompts. It supplies a broad intended use for some names but does not publish complete item mechanics.
groups.disposition: Treat detailed CSV mechanics as owner-delegated authored completion, never recovered source fact. Preserve reversibility and route item mechanics/balance to PPIA-03/PPIA-11.

groups.source_support: The PDF explicitly defines the parent fusion, base ability theme, and named Hybrid Synergy Ability for all three. Pyrostorm explicitly gives a 10-foot Storm Burst radius. Exact damage/healing, uses, cooldowns/recovery, activation, and weight are otherwise not published.
groups.disposition: Preserve source fusion identities and narrative effects; keep non-stated quantities/uses/recovery as reversible recommendations routed to PPIA-05/PPIA-11.

groups.source_support: Cybernetics.PDF explicitly supplies a core effect or numerical bonus for every listed record, including Stealth Generator +2 Stealth/+2 Disguise; social implants +2 Charisma contexts; defensive AC/absorption effects; Plasma Blaster 1d8 energy/+2 hit; Thermal Ray 1d6 fire/+2 hit; and Light Refractor +2 Charisma for deception. The current inferred duration/uses/range where absent, recovery, removal/detachment, and weight are not source facts.
groups.disposition: Retain published core effect values; keep operational fill explicitly inferred and route balance/implant lifecycle decisions to PPIA-03/PPIA-05/PPIA-11.

groups.source_support: Items 1.PDF page 30 publishes Taser as 1d4 Lightning damage, 1 lb., 50 gp; Stun Gun as electric damage with range dependent on model, 2 lbs., 500 gp; and Tranquilizer Gun as knocking out biological targets, 3 lbs., 500 gp. Page 39 separately publishes a Police Equipment Taser as 1d6 non-lethal damage, stun for 1 round, 1 lb., 300 credits.

record_dispositions.name: Taser
record_dispositions.current_csv_issue: The CSV uses the page-30 1d4 Lightning / 50 gp identity while its inferred 1-round stun matches the separate page-39 Police Equipment Taser. This conflates two source contexts.
record_dispositions.recommendation: Do not auto-merge. Preserve two source variants or a governed variant relationship distinguished by source context/currency/effect. Do not treat the page-39 stun as source text for the page-30 Taser.

record_dispositions.name: Stun Gun
record_dispositions.recommendation: Preserve source effect/weight/cost and source statement that range is model-dependent. Keep 10-shot battery, 1-round stun, and fixed 30-ft range as non-source recommendations unless a controlling source is recovered.

record_dispositions.name: Tranquilizer Gun
record_dispositions.recommendation: Preserve knockout effect/weight/cost. Keep six darts, one-hour unconsciousness, and 30/90-ft range as non-source recommendations unless a controlling source is recovered.

groups.disposition: Resolve the Taser source conflation as a variant/identity issue; preserve the other two as source-backed item identities with explicitly inferred operational details. Route final combat/balance values to PPIA-03/PPIA-11.
